Title: GeomasterApiSubscriptionImpactAllRequests
Description:
the number of impacted subscriptions exceeded the threshold in the last 30 minutes for alerting. This will create an auto-post. The thresholds are different. ARM data is used for comms and only subs with 5 or more request with status 429 or 5xx are notified. You can get this list by executing the function GeoSubImpact in our central or west us Kusto clusters. The call looks like the below, just update the datetime to the incident start time. This alert should correlate to the NonGet alert and only post once.

Execute: [Web] [Web (Lens)] [Desktop] [Desktop (SAW)] https://wawscus.kusto.windows.net:443/wawsprod GeoSubImpact(datetime(2018-11-07 20:00:00), now())


Geomaster dashboard link: https://jarvis-west.dc.ad.msft.net/dashboard/WAWS/Deployments/Regional%2520GeoMaster%2520check (Make sure to select the correct cluster and eventstampname!!!)


Mitigation: TSG: GeomasterApiSubscriptionImpactAllRequests  (Web view)

If the above mitigation does not help and the CPU usage on the geomaster or stamp database is very high - use this TSG to mitigate:

TSG: SQL investigations - High CPU usage on Hosting or Geomaster database (Web view)


If this does not help then involve the Control Plane team - Antares Management Loop Team in ICM.

PrimaryKustoQuery.Title: Primary kusto query
PrimaryKustoQuery.KustoQuery:
AntaresAdminGeoEvents 
| where TIMESTAMP > ago(30m)
| where EventId == 40006
| where Address !contains "/resourceGroups/Learn-" // Ignoring requests from internal customer until they finish cleanup (see ICM 136373940)
| where Address !contains '/Microsoft.DomainRegistration'
| where Address !contains '/Microsoft.Web/billingMeters'
| where ClientAppId !in ("8edd93e1-2103-40b4-bd70-6e34e586362d", "1d78a85d-813d-46f0-b496-dd72f50a3ec0", "83e638ef-7885-479f-bbe8-9150acccdb3d", 
                        "8edd93e1-2103-40b4-bd70-6e34e586362d", "8bdebf23-c0fe-4187-a378-717ad86f6a53", "509e4652-da8d-478d-a730-e9d4a1996ca4",
                        "11c174dc-1945-4a9a-a36b-c79a0f246b9b", "544c7d8d-0634-424d-a512-31de515f1108" // Ignore 429s - IcM 357850558
                        )
| extend TargetHostName = replace_regex(TargetHostName, ":[0-9]+", "") // Collapse target hostnames with and without ports into 1
| where IsGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName)
| project Verb, StatusCode, ApiType, EventId, SubscriptionId , EventStampName, AddressTemplate, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName, ExtendedErrorCode
| summarize totalReqs = count() , failedReqs = countif(StatusCode >= 500 or (StatusCode == 429 and ExtendedErrorCode !in (51020,59207))) by SubscriptionId, EventStampName, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName
| extend availability = 100-(failedReqs*100.0/totalReqs)
| summarize totalSubs = count(), affectedSubs = countif(availability < 100) by EventStampName, SourceNamespace, TargetHostName
| extend impact = affectedSubs*100.0/ totalSubs 
| extend impactThreshold = GetSubImpactThresholdByEventStampNameAndTotalSubs(EventStampName, totalSubs)
| where impact > impactThreshold and affectedSubs > 5
| where totalSubs > 10
| extend TargetLocation = substring(TargetHostName, 0, indexof(TargetHostName, "."))
| where TargetLocation !endswith "-cs" // Exclude the -CS proxy endpoint - only used during IP migration for geomasters and can cause false alarms to fire
| extend CorrelationId = iff(IsRegionalGeomasterByEventStampName(EventStampName) and TargetLocation != replace_string(EventStampName, "rgm-prod-", "")
    , strcat("rgm-prod-", TargetLocation), EventStampName)
| extend MonitorId = strcat(SourceNamespace, iif(EventStampName contains "int", "Not", "")
    , "ApiAutoPost")
    , CorrelationId
    , titlePrefix = iif(SourceNamespace startswith "waws" and EventStampName !contains "int", "[AppServiceCP][AutoComms],", "[AppServiceCP],")
| project-away SourceNamespace
